scenario.task: Write down something you need to remember, while the phone keeps losing its signal, and make sure it is still there afterwards.

entry.state: the list of notes, with one existing note called Shopping list

perturbations.note: the train goes into a tunnel
a phone call comes in and takes over the screen

preconditions: The app is installed, signed in, and has one note called Shopping list
The device starts with a working connection

success_criteria: The new note appears in the list after the connection comes back
The new note is still in the list after the app is closed and reopened
The app showed or read out whether the note had been saved

out_of_scope: Anything requiring a photo to be taken
